title: Count lines sized on own waits?
text: T-3931's fix sizes a headway line's round trip on its trains' own waits at the ends. Lines set by count (and the Tokyo fixtures) still lose trains at the ends the same way; sizing theirs the same way would lower their rate and move every departure. File a task for it? I'd file it P3 and leave it until the T-3931 fix itself can land (it is held for T-3231).
